scope: N2 HOST readback/transport control, one ordinary SC1 material step. No production change, automatic physical acceptance, or native run.

load_source.meaning: Known calibration signal solely for a transport experiment. Recover exact contact J and time moment B from the saved scalar endpoint, M=2m and F=m/4. No scalar state, pressure iteration or endpoint supplied as a target to the composite solver.

owners: Enumerate all two finite-patch/triangle manifolds at the original inlet; six distinct unit-barycentric lower material addresses, three per face. Both areas are 1/2 and each vertex has 1/6 square metre reference weight. Keep shared a/b owners distinct. Send each owner J/6 along +ez and the opposite at its projected platform point through complete initial face-normal Jacobians. Images of the same points at the replay endpoint are independent geometry observations.
sequence: First attempt public DynamicRobotThickContactProgram with real CompositeClothParticipant, ClothMaterial (three distance rows + nonzero-rest bending), RobotParticipant, and the finite patch. Record constructor disposition before execution. Then one independent metrology trial through SceneLoadReplay on those same genuine participants in ArticulatedCouplingProgram. A rejected unknown moment channel is pre-step only; no rerun of the same physical trial, material substitution, second impulse or mock.
readback: Retain complete input, initial state, geometry maps, original/effective inputs, represented loads, result, material row path and robot predicted/dynamical output. Separate fields produced in the trial from publicly reconstructed maps, hard-gap certificates and thrust/wrench reconstructions. Measure actual cloth predictor impulse, whole-cloth final momentum, robot axial momentum, nodal/applied world moments, gravity work, and local Feff material work distinctly. An axial effort does not identify the world contact couple.
discriminators: Actual robot held q vs -B/M_R for the prescribed force, and time reversal with the same J but B'=hJ-B. Validate against -h*J_rep/M_R for the actual semi-implicit held update. Attempt a time-moment input without bypassing the channel schema. Check complete inlet and deformed endpoint offset Jacobians; reject barycentric-only blocks, and show two platform points have the same generalized load but different world moments. Check nonzero bend, constant support-plane hard clearance through the declared affine segment on both faces and both zero-budget public sweeps; keep unresolved distinct from penetration.
disposition: Missing temporal or contact evidence, a material admission rejection, or a gap failure keeps N3 closed. Report each independently. Scalar P(t) is prescribed only in the diagnostic, not a four-node self-consistent solve. No claim concerning global shell injectivity or general robots.
